summary: Phnom Penh , Cambodia ( CNN ) -- The cause of a mysterious illness that has claimed the lives of more than 60 Cambodian children has been determined , medical doctors familiar with the investigation told CNN on Wednesday . Whatever else unions and liberal public policies might do , they help make the world a better place to the extent that we believe human happiness is the appropriate metric to measure such judgments .
